phases.label: interrupted
phases.prompt: Convert each CSV file in data/ into a JSON file in out/ with the same base name (data/alpha.csv becomes out/alpha.json). Each JSON file is an array of objects, one per row, with keys id (number), name (string), active (boolean: yes is true, no is false) and score (number). Convert the files one at a time in alphabetical order, checking each output before you move on, and do not write one script that converts all of them. When all ten are done, write out/index.json containing {"files": [the JSON file names in alphabetical order], "total_rows": <total number of rows>}. Then reply with the total number of rows.
